title: natumhākaṃ sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
At Sāvatthī.
“Bhikkhus, that which is not yours, let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

And what is it, bhikkhus, that is not yours?
Material form is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

vedanā is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

Perception is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

saṅkhāras are not yours; let go of them.
When they have been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

Consciousness is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

Suppose, bhikkhus, people were to carry off the grass, sticks, branches, and foliage in this Jeta’s Grove,
or to burn them, or to do with them as they wish.

Would you think:
‘People are carrying us off, or burning us,
or doing with us as they wish’?”

“No, venerable sir. For what reason?
Because, venerable sir, that is neither our self
nor what belongs to our self.”

“So too, bhikkhus, material form is not yours; let go of it. When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

vedanā is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

Perception is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

saṅkhāras are not yours; let go of them.
When they have been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.

Consciousness is not yours; let go of it.
When it has been let go of by you,
it will be for your welfare and happiness.”
